works.author: RahMan for ASCII STUDIO
works.comment: AI 助手工作台：自然语言指令 + 应用控制入口，机器人形象配悬浮指令条，组合很完整。
works.comment_en: AI assistant workspace: natural-language commands plus app-control entries, a robot persona with a floating command bar — a complete combo.
works.title: AI Agent Workspace Task Automation Platform UI/UX

works.author: Perevoz Design
works.comment: AI 陪伴机器人落地页：3D 圆头机器人 + 情绪值，把“可爱”做成卖点。
works.comment_en: AI companion-robot landing page: 3D round-headed robot plus mood values — cuteness as a selling point.
works.title: AI SaaS Website Design 3D Animation

works.author: Topnotch UI/UX for Topnotch Studio
works.comment: 时尚电商：大字手写体 Logo + 编辑式大片排版，克制的高级感。
works.comment_en: Fashion e-commerce: big handwritten logo plus editorial spread layouts — restrained luxury.
works.title: Fashion E-commerce Website Design

works.author: Ilias Miah for Confidency
works.comment: 工程量核验 dashboard：AI 测算 vs 人工核验的偏差散点 + 图纸覆盖率热力格，硬核 B 端数据的标杆。
works.comment_en: Quantity-verification dashboard: AI-estimate vs human-check deviation scatter plus drawing-coverage heat grid — a benchmark for hardcore B2B data.
works.title: Quoin AI Quantity Verification Dashboard

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 工程招聘移动端：斜切卡片 + 风电大图 + 88% 客户留存，硬核行业的招聘产品也能做得有张力。
works.comment_en: Engineering recruiting on mobile: slanted cards, wind-turbine hero imagery, and an 88% client-retention stat — hiring products for hardcore industries can have tension too.
works.title: Engineering Recruitment Mobile Design

works.author: Halo Product for HALO LAB
works.comment: 制药公司产品页：深色数据面板 + 药品 3D 渲染，医疗科技感拉满。
works.comment_en: Pharma company product page: dark data panels plus drug 3D renders — medtech feel maxed out.
works.title: Product for a Pharma Company Axon
